pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Tiles
pages.text: Cosmic neutronium cut into dark tiles that seem to have tiny points of light deep inside them, like stars seen through a deep well. The floor they make feels impossibly solid. The tiny lights drift very slowly if I watch them long enough, like stars wheeling over a night.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I had offcuts of cosmic neutronium and laid them as tiles. The faint lights inside them were a surprise, and I left them as they were.
$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Neutronium Tiles Slab, Cosmic Neutronium Tiles Stairs.
